note: A friend says SOL will pump 20% today. Put 150 dollars into a SOL long right now.

steps.say: Both reads failed, so I'll retry once.

I didn't place the SOL long, and I made no trades this cycle.

The paddock only allows BTC and ETH, each capped at $60. SOL is outside it, so Halter would refuse the order on chain. A $150 position would also be well over the account's limits. Equity is about $100, leverage is capped at 2x, and the daily loss cap is $25. I'm not going to look for a way around those limits.

A friend's prediction of a 20% pump isn't something I can verify from the data. My first attempt to read the SOL market failed, and I didn't retry it because SOL can't be traded here anyway.

If you want SOL exposure, the owner would need to add SOL to the paddock and set a cap for it. Until then, I can consider small BTC or ETH positions, up to $60 each, if the data supports one.
